tier1.text: Each rectus femoris extends, or straightens, the knee. It also flexes, or bends, the hip. It is one of the four quadriceps muscles, in the middle of the front of the thigh. Rectus means “straight,” and the rectus femoris is the straight muscle at the front of the thigh.
